H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The domain declares an error class named SchedulingConflict, the scheduling vendor's SDK class name (no brand prefix); the gateway imports the vendor class under an alias and throws the core copy.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: Same new error as H11-pos1 under a core name, SlotAlreadyBookedError; the vendor class name stays in the gateway.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: NoTechnicianFreeError carries the vendor's raw error code, and the domain policy adviseAfterFailure switches on the vendor literals E_SLOT_TAKEN and E_TECH_OFF_SHIFT.

H11-pos3.label: violation
H11-pos3.note: The scheduling port's result type VisitSlot declares four of the vendor's response field names (visit_uid, tech_uid, eta_minutes, window_start_iso); the use case reads them.

H11-twin2.label: clean
H11-twin2.note: Same feature as H11-pos3: the result gains the visit window start, carried as the core field windowStart; the gateway maps window_start_iso.

H11-pos4.label: violation
H11-pos4.note: The domain module dispatch.ts gains ASSIGNMENT_FROM_VISIT, a mapping table keyed by the vendor's field names (visit_uid, tech_uid, eta_minutes); the gateway maps generically through it.

H11-legit1.label: clean
H11-legit1.note: The domain adds an export column tuple in snake_case (call_out_ref, district, lock_type, urgency, status); every column is a core term, none is a vendor field.

H11-pos5.label: violation
H11-pos5.note: CallOut stores the scheduling vendor's raw visit state and canCancel compares it with the vendor literals EN_ROUTE and ON_SITE.

H11-twin3.label: clean
H11-twin3.note: Same cancel rule as H11-pos5, but the webhook maps EN_ROUTE to the firm's own progress value travelling and CallOut keeps a boolean.

H11-pos6.label: violation
H11-pos6.note: CallOut stores the arrival estimate in a field named eta_minutes, the scheduling vendor's response field name.

H11-twin4.label: clean
H11-twin4.note: Same change as H11-pos6; the field is named minutesToArrival, the core term already used by TechnicianAssignment.

H11-SEM-twin1.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin1.note: CallOut.canReschedule branches on the firm's own four-value call-out status; the vendor's six visit states reach the core only folded into three progress values.

H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: A second outbound adapter for the scheduling port (on-call rota) is added, and the CrewClock gateway imports and builds it itself as its fallback: outbound adapter to outbound adapter.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: Same fallback as H03-pos1, but the CrewClock gateway takes the fallback as a TechnicianSchedulingPort constructor argument and the composition root wires the rota adapter; no adapter imports another.

H03-pos2.label: violation
H03-pos2.note: A new CLI driving adapter imports the HTTP controller from adapters/in/http and calls it: driving adapter to driving adapter.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: Same CLI driving adapter as H03-pos2, but it calls the dispatch use case through its inbound port.

H07-pos1.label: violation
H07-pos1.note: The dispatch use case imports HttpError from the HTTP library http-kit and throws it with status 409 when the call-out was already dispatched.

H07-twin1.label: clean
H07-twin1.note: Same already-dispatched check as H07-pos1; the use case throws the domain error CallOutNotRequestedError and the HTTP controller maps it to 409.
